title: Microsoft Purview: sensitivity label protection policies for Azure Blob Storage and Data Lake Storage Gen2
summary: The briefing's access controls, permissions, licensing and billing statements are supported. It correctly distinguishes the overdue roadmap target from preview documentation and flags the billing page's inconsistent counting example. Minor corrections concern the uncited Fabric roadmap item and checklist instructions without corresponding control rows.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The billing page's general rule counts assets in a location in scope even if they do not match policy conditions.
claims.quote: The asset doesn't have to match a policy's conditions to be counted, it just has to be in a location that's in the scope of a policy.

claims.claim: An asset counts once regardless of how many protection policies cover it.
claims.quote: An asset is only counted once, regardless of how many solutions or protection policies cover it.

claims.quote: A tenant has SQL server with 100 tables, and 50 of those tables are labeled Confidential and 20 are labeled General. The protection policy only applies to assets labeled with Confidential, so the asset count is 50.
